key_idea: Track a three-state machine per item (unseen, picked up, delivered) in a hash map; every transition must be the next legal one and every item must end delivered.
sketch: Keep a map from item name to state 0/1/2. A pickup is legal only from state 0, a dropoff only from state 1; anything else marks the schedule invalid. At the end every item seen must be in state 2 (catches pickup without delivery). O(total length) expected. Pitfalls: a second pickup after delivery (sample 4) and dropoff-before-pickup must both fail, so a simple counter of pickups minus dropoffs is not enough.
